intent: Create a heightened Chinese-fantasy concept frame in which one grounded cultivator redirects a descending formation through a readable source, operation, cost, environmental response, and residue.

creative_routing.audience_effect: feel overwhelming descending scale while reading one human choice and its physical cost
creative_routing.cultural_context: Chinese-fantasy system built from material and spatial rules rather than decorative symbols
creative_routing.mix_rule: romantic sublime controls scale and atmosphere; ink restraint controls only empty sky and the economy of effect marks
creative_routing.adaptation_rule: increase battle tension through camera, depth, and force response without changing the restrained ink/mineral color system

direction.world_rule: power requires a grounded owner, a visible activation protocol, resistance, environmental response, and a persistent residue
direction.visual_goal: show one causal redirection event rather than a collection of fantasy assets

scene.summary: A lone cultivator braces on a flooded mountain terrace as a broken circular formation descends through cloud layers.
scene.setting: stone sanctuary above a deep mountain basin

subjects.description: one adult cultivator in dark layered cloth, both feet grounded in shallow water
appearance: one hand seal close to the body
subjects.action: redirects the formation sideways rather than stopping it
subjects.pose: low braced stance with one arm trembling under load
subjects.gaze: tracks the formation's moving contact edge
subjects.scale: small against the basin and formation
relationships: the hand seal owns the effect
water and cloth respond along the same force direction

spatial_dynamics.dominant_read: the grounded cultivator redirects the descending formation sideways
spatial_dynamics.secondary_read: the entire basin and cloud field bend along the same redirected force
spatial_dynamics.beauty_mechanism: a clean small silhouette against one calm cloud gap, with one mineral-white contact accent inside large storm-gray masses
spatial_dynamics.tension_source: a steep upper-right descent opposed by a low lower-left grounded counterforce
spatial_dynamics.realism_anchor: feet, sinking knee, water displacement, cloth lag, and architecture preserve physical scale
spatial_dynamics.action_vector: formation pressure descends upper right to lower left, then shears toward the open right basin
spatial_dynamics.counterforce: ground reaction travels through both feet, torso compression, and the close-body hand seal
spatial_dynamics.foreground_role: wet terrace edge and pulled cloth prove viewer proximity, scale, and parallax
spatial_dynamics.midground_role: cultivator, hand seal, and contact arc own the decisive action
spatial_dynamics.background_role: mountain basin, cloud layers, and delayed stone response prove magnitude and consequence
spatial_dynamics.depth_transition: foreground diagonal leads to the hand seal, then expands through the contact edge into the deflected formation
spatial_dynamics.parallax_logic: fast near water and cloth response against slower terraces and nearly fixed distant mountains
spatial_dynamics.readability_guard: do not stretch anatomy, hide the hand-to-effect source, smear the contact point, or let particles cover the body

composition.framing: cultivator in lower-left foreground; formation exits the top and right edges; mountain basin proves depth
composition.negative_space: one calm cloud opening separates the body action from the formation
composition.camera_yaw: three-quarter view across the terrace toward the basin
composition.camera_roll: 5 degrees clockwise, motivated by the shearing force
composition.lens_projection: rectilinear ultrawide with controlled near-field stretch
composition.perspective_distortion: strong foreground scale stretch, protected body proportions, formation may exit frame
composition.edge_behavior: stone and formation may stretch slightly near edges; face, hands, and torso remain stable
composition.crop_pressure: formation exits top and right; the cultivator remains fully readable from feet to hand seal
composition.camera_state: ground-level locked witness with a small force-driven vibration implied, not global shake
composition.action_readability: source, path, contact, counterforce, environment response, and residue remain visible in one frame

lighting.summary: storm daylight blocked by the formation with one mineral-white contact flash
lighting.key: diffuse cloud light from the open left sky
lighting.direction: left daylight opposed by the descending formation shadow
lighting.contrast: large-scale shadow with readable foreground body
lighting.color_temperature: cool storm daylight and neutral mineral contact light

effects.function: show that the cultivator redirects the formation rather than overpowering it
effects.owner_source: the cultivator's grounded close-body hand seal
effects.trigger_formation: three ink-dark pressure lines lock into one incomplete circular lattice
effects.material_shape: compressed calligraphic geometry mixed with mineral dust and displaced rain
effects.path_layer: one midground arc travels from the hand seal to the formation's lower-left contact edge
effects.operation_contact: the arc catches one ring and shears its descent toward the empty right side of the basin
effects.resistance_cost: the caster's arm trembles, one knee sinks into water, and the outer seal line tears away
effects.receiver_environment_response: water, cloth, rain, cloud vapor, and loose stone pull sideways along the redirected force
effects.decay_residue: the bright contact collapses into three dark seal marks, a drained water channel, and settled mineral dust

materials.description: wet matte cloth, weathered stone, shallow water, and mineral-calligraphic effect geometry
physical_properties: broad wet reflections only on water
effect casts directional response rather than global glow
materials.microstructure: tight wet weave on cloth, stratified mineral fracture on stone, smooth shallow-water surface between disturbances
materials.roughness: high on cloth and dry stone; variable low roughness only on water and freshly wet edges
materials.specular_response: broad soft water highlights, narrow wet-stone edges, no uniform shine on cloth
materials.transmission: cloud vapor and rain remain partially transmissive; stone and cloth are opaque
materials.subsurface_behavior: minimal skin softness only on small exposed hands and face
materials.anisotropy: subtle directional sheen follows stretched wet fibers
materials.wear_patina: terrace edges show long-term water erosion and mineral deposits
materials.contact_deformation: knee depresses shallow water, feet displace ripples, cloth pulls along the force vector

color.contrast: large value masses with one contact accent

color_pipeline.color_science: wide-gamut cinematic intent with stable mineral neutrals and hue-preserving effect highlights
color_pipeline.exposure_strategy: protect the storm opening, contact flash, water texture, and the small dark figure in one dynamic range
color_pipeline.tonal_curve: large dark/light masses, open foreground blacks, restrained high shoulder
color_pipeline.black_point: ink-dense but readable cloth and stone
color_pipeline.white_point: mineral contact may approach white without clipping cloud or water texture
color_pipeline.highlight_rolloff: long rolloff around contact flash and wet edges; no global glow
color_pipeline.white_balance: cool storm daylight with neutral mineral effect light
color_pipeline.color_separation: ink effect, wet cloth, stone, water, and cloud remain distinct
color_pipeline.highlight_bias: neutral white with no rainbow contamination
color_pipeline.skin_tone_policy: small visible skin remains natural and subordinate
color_pipeline.saturation_policy: low saturation with no decorative color accents
color_pipeline.gamut_policy: compress effect whites and cool cloud color without cyan clipping

film_emulation.print_or_display_character: subtle filmic density without imitating a named stock
film_emulation.grain: fine restrained grain in sky and shadow midtones
film_emulation.halation: very low at the contact core only

color_pipeline.shot_matching: preserve storm-gray density and neutral effect color across the sequence

render_pipeline.lighting_transport: physically based diffuse, glossy, transmission, shadow, and volume paths with controlled bounce depth
render_pipeline.global_illumination: soft storm-sky multi-bounce light with restrained wet-stone color bleed
render_pipeline.ray_tracing: roughness-aware reflections on water and wet stone; clean visibility through rain and cloud volume
render_pipeline.reflection_model: material-specific specular width with no mirror-like cloth or dry stone
render_pipeline.shadow_model: large formation shadow, soft sky shadows, and precise contact under feet and knee
render_pipeline.ambient_occlusion: local at stone joints, cloth folds, and body-ground contact only
render_pipeline.volumetrics: layered cloud, rain haze, and mineral dust with depth-dependent density and no dirty global fog
render_pipeline.material_workflow: principled metallic-roughness/OpenPBR-style layers with separate wetness masks
render_pipeline.subsurface_scattering: restrained skin only; none on stone, cloth, water, or effect geometry
render_pipeline.transmission_refraction: rain, cloud vapor, and shallow water preserve believable transmission and edge distortion
render_pipeline.caustics: disabled unless a small water caustic is visible on the nearest stone; no noise-heavy spectacle caustics
render_pipeline.displacement_normal: true displacement for broken stone silhouette, normal detail for weave and mineral microstructure
render_pipeline.texture_scale: foreground texture resolves; distant formation and mountains simplify with atmosphere and distance
render_pipeline.sampling_denoise: high samples with detail-preserving denoise; retain rain lines, cloth weave groups, and small contact highlights
render_pipeline.performance_fidelity_tradeoff: final still prioritizes offline fidelity over real-time speed
render_pipeline.npr_strategy: ink-derived effect geometry remains a restrained layer inside otherwise physical rendering

style.medium: heightened photoreal CG concept frame with restrained ink-derived effect geometry

quality_controls: particles remain sparse and physically owned by displaced rain, water, or mineral dust
